items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow (X-rays negative, no fracture); ruled out, expected to miss time (prior similar injury ~1 month). Additional testing Monday.
items.why: Freak fall bracing after OL stepped on foot late first half; same elbow as prior dislocation.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade for WAS; Marcus Mariota likely starts short-term. Monitor imaging.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream/start; elevated roles for WAS pass-catchers if volume holds, but offense downgrade overall.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE for Week 2 vs Raiders after optimism and Friday limited practice; would wear flak jacket.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, team did not elevate WR; Rapoport bullish tone earlier.
items.implication: Start with possible docks for limited snaps/effectiveness; primary target remains if healthy enough.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route share expected if cleared fully; flak jacket may limit some physicality.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive for Week 2; was not expected to play.
items.why: Hamstring issue; ETR/Levitan flagged as not expected.
items.implication: Sit; opens backfield opportunity for backups.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining RBs, notably Jonah Coleman look per Levitan/Berry.

items.text: Raiders HC on TE Brock Bowers: 'Close, very close. He looks great.' (was doubtful/OUT earlier).
items.implication: Imminent return boosts LV TE/pass game; stash if dropped.

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return with chest injury.
items.implication: Monitor; SEA RB depth tested if limited.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans has hip injury, questionable to return; Shanahan says doesn't look serious. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
items.why: In-game hip; coach notes not serious.
items.implication: Likely returns or short-term; monitor postgame.
items.opportunity: If out remainder/next: other SF WRs/TEs up.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason. Also loves Germie Bernard stash (YAC, McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Confirmed actives/inactives + preseason advocacy + fit notes.
items.implication: McConkey play; add Coleman/Bernard where available for upside.
items.opportunity: Coleman immediate RB2/flex path; Bernard deep WR upside.

items.text: Packers ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck/head); has feeling/movement, overnight observation/testing.
items.implication: Sit rest of day/next; GB WR targets to others (Wicks, Watson, etc.).
items.opportunity: Elevated GB WR2/3 and TE usage.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return in Week 2 game.
items.implication: Monitor return; if limited/out, Gainwell or committee elevates.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps if sits remainder.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is ACTIVE and will play Week 2.
items.why: Cleared after back issue; Rapoport confirmed will play earlier.
items.implication: Full start; CIN pass game online with Chase etc.
items.opportunity: Normal usage projected; no docks expected from ETR.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is ACTIVE for Week 2; ETR/Levitan saw clean bill with no real docks.
items.why: Hamstring cleared; expected to play per weekend reports.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) is a true game-time decision for MNF; later reports trending wrong way/more likely to sit after missing practices.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, DNPs Fri/Sat; Schefter notes wrong direction/pregame decision.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out, Adams/Kyren elevate.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Davante Adams target share surge, TE/RB involvement up.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late. Olave clean/no docks; Harvey doubtful opens Coleman; Pittman out opens Bernard.
items.why: Practice reports, insider tone, role clarity on absences.
items.implication: McConkey startable with caution; Olave full go; stash/stream Coleman/Bernard in deeper formats.
items.opportunity: Coleman RB opportunity spike; Bernard WR YAC/McCarthy fit.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT for Week 2; opens door for increased Bateman usage.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed in ETR weekend summary and Rapoport notes.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for remaining WRs (Bateman highlighted).

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) is OUT; ETR/Levitan expect decent look at Germie Bernard (YAC fit).
items.why: Foot injury; listed OUT in weekend reports.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for slot/depth WRs; Bernard stash/upgrade per Levitan/Berry.

items.text: Colston Loveland heats up for 1/3 vs Vikings; Berry reaction 'Damn'.
items.why: Production spike in CHI TE role.
items.implication: TE streaming/upside candidate if volume sustains.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; now 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yards, TD in each of first two team games.
items.opportunity: Continued high routes/targets/red-zone in SEA offense.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd scores first career TD; congrats to those who waited over 2 years.
items.why: First career score in GB backfield.
items.implication: Depth chart progress; monitor for expanded role.
